runtime_dt: Linux arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sm8650-ayaneo-pocket-s2.dts (+ RFC touch node, see fixture)
rfc: arm64: dts: qcom: sm8650-ayaneo-pocket-s2: add display nodes (lkml 2604.3/08167), touch node only

keys.VolumeUp: gpio-keys pm8550_gpios 6, active low, debounce 15 ms

pcie1.smmu: stream 0x1480/0x1481 (must be bypass, not programmed by kShimC)

phy.supplies: vdda-phy vreg_l3e_0p9 (ldoe3), vdda-pll vreg_l3i_1p2 (ldoi3; regulator-name says 0p91), vdda-qref vreg_l1i_0p88 (ldoi1)

endpoint.supplies: avdd33 TLMM 123, vdd10 TLMM 122, vdd33 TLMM 121 (regulator-fixed, active-high, vin vph_pwr)
endpoint.firmware: renesas_usb_fw.mem from super/vendor{slot}/firmware unless ROM or already running

touch.reset: TLMM 161 active-high as written in the RFC (unverified)
touch.pinctrl: ts_reset_default gpio161 pull-down 8 mA, ts_irq_default gpio162 bias-disable 8 mA
